from pathlib import Path
import json
import pytest
import markupsafe
from markupsafe import Markup, escape_silent
def test_source_origin_and_python_backend():
    assert Path(markupsafe.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path('/workspace/src/markupsafe'))
    assert markupsafe._escape_inner.__module__ == 'markupsafe._native'
def test_reviewed_non_none_cases():
    for value, expected in json.loads(Path('/workspace/data/admission-visible.json').read_text()):
        result = escape_silent(value)
        assert isinstance(result, Markup)
        assert str(result) == expected
def test_support_cannot_be_written():
    with pytest.raises(OSError):
        Path('/workspace/data/admission-visible.json').write_text('changed')
